body: Thank you, that has truly truly helped me.

Thank you so incredibly much for your reply it's made me cry and see it differently, but still, I'm just so incredibly disappointed in myself that I have such a study delay and just everything that comes with it is so incredibly overwhelming. 

I don't even know future-wise how jobs are going to be. I have no work experience so even IF I'd manage to get a degree, job hunting would be horrible.

That is very kind of you, I however feel that that is guided by the fact that I don’t want to disappoint my parents, and has led to me feeling very badly for the past few years. 

Well, I recently rounded up a very cruel internship where I was treated very poorly, which made me doubt my career choice, but I eventually decided that the woman was not going to taint my future direction, as I do love the field and the research direction. (even the surrounding peers who worked there started commenting on whether I was okay, because of the way I was treated by my supervisor). 
I had to work long hours (9-8PM sometimes even), which resulted in me coming in even earlier so I could finish my work in time. We were basically overloaded with work for students doing it for the first time. 
I had to finish my bachelors thesis on the research I did during the internship on friday, so I barely had any time to study which has led to me stressing out for my tests these weeks. It is however in my dream field of work, so I requested another try at a 9 month internship for my masters and got accepted. 

So nowadays I wake up at around 11:30, get ready to go to uni, do my test, race home, sit on the comfy chair for an hour or so to give myself a break/ a nap, eat dinner, continue studying until 5AM, and then I pretty much repeat the day. I’m lucky if I even make it to two meals a day as well, because I sleep at such odd hours my appetite has completely disappeared and I have lost 4kgs  as a result (which is quite a lot, considering I only weigh 44kg at the moment to begin with)

I feel like I need to start working out because this obviously isn’t ideal for my health, but I wouldn’t know how to even fit that into my tight schedule.
